question: In an equilateral triangle ABC of side 18 cm, what is the sum (in cm) of the perpendicular distances of the centroid G from the sides of the triangle?
solution:
**Given:**

Side of equilateral triangle = 18 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × a²

Area = (1 ÷ 2) × a × (sum of perpendicular distances from centroid)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × 18²

⇒ Area = (√3 &d
ivide; 4) × 324

⇒ Area = 81√3

⇒ 81√3 = (1 ÷ 2) × 18 × (sum of distances)

⇒ 81√3 = 9 × (sum of distances)

⇒ Sum of distances = 81√3 ÷ 9

⇒ Sum of distances = 9√3

**∴ The correct answer is 9√3 cm.**
